### What does this PR do?

Capture evidence for the Ascend nightly-ci Qwen3-VL accuracy regression. Local runs of the failing CI revision have not reproduced the collapse, so the full Qwen3-VL nightly job now saves environment/content fingerprints, bounded per-worker weight-path records, and full training logs as an artifact.

This is diagnostic instrumentation, not a proposed numerical fix. Default metadata mode does not copy tensors, read tensor values, synchronize devices, or introduce collectives. Python/file I/O can still affect timing. An explicitly selected values mode adds synchronization and local-shard SHA256/nonfinite checks for a separate intrusive control.

Duplicate-work check: open PR searches for `8187 in:body`, `Ascend diagnostics`, and `offload logging` found no implementation of this environment plus FSDP2/rollout diagnostic path. Related results address PEFT compatibility, Megatron allocation failures, or FP8 quantization auditing rather than this investigation.

AI assistance was used to implement and test these diagnostics. This draft is for the submitting human to review every changed line, run the relevant Ascend CI, and assess the results before requesting final review or merging.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [8187 references](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+8187+in%3Abody), [Ascend diagnostics](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+Ascend+diagnostics), [offload logging](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+offload+logging).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

- `python -m unittest discover -s tests/utils -p 'test_*diagnostics_on_cpu.py' -v`: 11 tests passed using CPU PyTorch. Covers redaction, fingerprints, missing evidence, subprocess timeout output, disabled diagnostics, metadata without tensor reads/copies, bounded logging, nonpersistent buffers, content corruption/nonfinite detection, transfer summaries, and write failure isolation.
- `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`: all hooks passed, including ruff, mypy, generated configs, license, test layout, and compileall.
- `ruby -rpsych -e 'Psych.parse_file(ARGV[0])' .github/workflows/nightly_ascend.yml`: passed.
- `git diff --cached --check`: passed.
- Parsed the workflow and verified ordinary PR triggering, unchanged schedules, exact equality of every other nightly job, unchanged runner/container and baseline checker, retained 16/32/16 launch configuration and the original 15-step launcher; verified the original E2E workflow is unchanged: passed.
- Ascend end-to-end execution remains pending. CPU checks do not establish NPU transfer correctness or absence of timing perturbations.

### API and Usage Example

The `nightly_ci_ascend` workflow now accepts ordinary `pull_request` events targeting main, filtered to relevant source/configuration/workflow/diagnostic paths. Opening, updating, or reopening a matching PR runs `nightlyCI_grpo_qwen3_vl_8b_Instruct_fsdp2_vllm_ascend` using the normal PR merge ref and repository approval process. No label or workflow_dispatch entry is needed.

This is the full nightly job: the original 16-NPU runner, container, 160 GiB shared memory, train batch 32, mini batch 16, launcher default 15 training steps, and baseline download/check remain. It does not depend on the E2E LLM job. The existing one-step E2E workflow is unchanged.

All schedules and all other nightly jobs are unchanged; their existing schedule conditions skip them on PR events. Re-running historical Actions still uses historical code.

For local collection, use `tests/special_npu/env_diagnostics/collect.py` with the same Python/container/model/data. Set `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR` to enable worker diagnostics, `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_MODE=metadata` by default, and `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_LIMIT=2` to bound records per process/stage/model.

Download `ascend-diagnostics-<run id>-<attempt>`: environment/report.json, weights/*.jsonl, weight-summary.json, full training output, original launcher log, and the downloaded baseline/checker. Artifacts are retained for 14 days and upload is attempted even after failure. Host loss/forced termination can still prevent upload.

### Design & Code Changes

- Stdlib environment collector records package origins and source/binary hashes, CANN/driver/firmware information, NPU topology, process/container resource limits, selected redacted environment variables, and complete model/data file hashes. Unknown image digest and incomplete probes remain explicit.
- FSDP2 records checkpoint input, set_model_state_dict completion, buffer broadcast completion, offload/reload boundaries, and actor export; vLLM records the first two incoming buckets and the model after loading. Ray explicitly forwards the three opt-in diagnostic variables.
- Each worker writes a separate JSONL with rank, model identity, local-shard layout/dtype/device/pinning, nonpersistent buffers, module origins, and mapped library paths.
- Values mode records full local tensor hashes and nonfinite counts; the summary compares only compatible same-process/same-model offload or reload pairs. It does not equate checkpoint full weights with FSDP/TP shards, audit every bucket, or prove end-to-end transfer correctness.
- Diagnostics never convert a missing hash or absent report into a numerical pass. Metadata summaries explicitly state that tensor integrity was not checked.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply pre-commit checks: `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`.
- [x] Add documentation: `tests/special_npu/env_diagnostics/README.md`.
- [x] Add CPU tests under the existing `tests/utils/test_*_on_cpu.py` discovery and wire artifact capture into the full Qwen3-VL nightly job for PR and scheduled runs.
- [ ] Human submitter reviews every changed line and runs the relevant Ascend validation before requesting final review.
- [ ] Request CI approval through the repository's existing process when ready. No Slack or Feishu message was sent.
- [ ] Update the recipe submodule if applicable. Not applicable here.

+# Ascend CI / 本地底软环境对照
+
+使用训练时的 Python、容器和环境变量，在训练启动前运行。采集器仅依赖 Python 标准库，
+不会安装软件、改驱动、改模型、分配测试 tensor、调用 synchronize 或执行训练。
+它会在一个有超时限制的独立进程里导入 torch / torch_npu / acl / vLLM 等，并查询设备。
+导入和文件哈希仍会改变启动耗时及文件缓存；这不是对时序完全无扰动的证明。
+
+## 采集
+
+在实际运行的 verl 源码根目录执行：
+
+```bash
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
+# 与此 Qwen3-VL nightly launcher 相同的导出值：
+export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=1500
+export HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=60000-60050
+export HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=61000-61050
+export RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
+
+python3 tests/special_npu/env_diagnostics/collect.py \
+  --label local --repo "$PWD" \
+  --asset /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct \
+  --asset /root/data/geo3k/train.parquet \
+  --asset /root/data/geo3k/test.parquet \
+  --output /root/results/ascend-env-local
+```
+
+使用独立下载包时，把命令中的脚本路径改成 `collect.py`。
+输出目录必须不存在。`--asset` 会对所有文件做完整 SHA256，读取 8B 模型可能需要数分钟。
+可重复传入实际 Hydra 配置文件、启动脚本、额外 checkpoint 或数据文件。
+非标准 CANN 安装目录用 `--cann-root /path/to/cann`，可重复指定。
+若导入时间较长，可以增加 `--import-timeout 300`。超时会记录错误并保留最后完成的导入结果。
+
+## CI 接入与触发
+
+`nightly_ci_ascend` 增加普通 `pull_request` 事件（目标 main，带源码／配置／诊断脚本路径过滤），不需要标签，不增加手动 dispatch 入口。
+
+- PR 创建、更新或重新打开时，命中路径过滤即可运行 `nightlyCI_grpo_qwen3_vl_8b_Instruct_fsdp2_vllm_ascend`。使用正常 PR merge ref，在合并前运行完整 Qwen3-VL nightly：16 卡、train batch 32、mini batch 16、launcher 默认 15 步、原有 baseline 下载和检查。
+- 该 job 无需等待 E2E 的 LLM job。原有 1-step `e2e_ascend` 文件保持不变，不额外接入这些诊断。
+- 定时事件保持不变；其他 nightly jobs 的条件和内容完全不变，因此 PR 事件下它们跳过。
+- 如果 PR CI 等待批准，按仓库既有流程请维护者批准，并在 PR 模板指定的 ci-request 渠道申请 CI。已有运行可使用 Re-run jobs，但须确认对应最新 PR 提交；重跑历史 Action 不会带上新增日志。
+
+Artifact 名为 `ascend-diagnostics-<run id>-<attempt>`，保留 14 天：
+
+- `environment/report.json`：环境、源码、模型和数据指纹。
+- `weights/<host>-<pid>.jsonl`：各 worker 的阶段记录，包含 rank、模型实例标识、实际导入路径、动态库路径、参数和 buffer 元信息。
+- `weight-summary.json`：阶段计数、非有限值和已记录 offload/reload 前后哈希不匹配；metadata 模式明确标记未校验数值，不输出通过结论。
+- `training-console.log` 及原始 launcher 日志：完整训练输出，避免 Actions 控制台截断。
+- 下载到本地的 baseline 和 checker：记录实际比较依据。
+
+上传步骤使用 always()；训练失败也尝试上传，但宿主机丢失或强制终止仍可能无法上传。
+
+### 权重诊断的边界
+
+默认 `metadata` 模式不读取张量数值，不增加 tensor copy、归约、同步或 collective；仍有 Python 和文件 I/O 开销，不能声称完全不影响时序。未设置 `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR` 时关闭。
+
+记录 checkpoint 输入、set_model_state_dict 后、buffer 广播后、CPU offload 前后、设备 reload 前后、actor 导出前、vLLM 收到 bucket 和加载完成后的状态。每进程每阶段每模型默认最多 2 次；bucket 仅记录前 2 个，不能据此声称覆盖全部传输。通过 `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_LIMIT` 调整。
+
+单独运行 `VERL_WEIGHT_DIAGNOSTICS_MODE=values` 才会同步设备、逐张量拷贝到 CPU，计算完整本地 shard SHA256 和非有限值数目。这是侵入性对照，可能掩盖竞态并增加 CPU 内存和耗时。CPU offload 前后同 rank、同模型、同名、同形状、同 dtype 的参数哈希应一致；checkpoint 输入是完整权重，FSDP 输出是 shard，vLLM 还会 TP 切分／融合，不能直接比较跨这些布局的哈希。该模式不自动证明 checkpoint 到 rollout 的端到端一致性。
+
+初始化前的 meta tensor 不计算哈希。仅有元信息不能确认权重没有损坏；先用 metadata 复现，再决定是否运行 values 对照。
+
+默认镜像 digest 为 `unknown`：容器内不能可靠推导宿主机实际拉取的 image digest。
+如果能在宿主机或启动平台查到它，通过 `--image-digest sha256:...` 或环境变量
+`REPRO_IMAGE_DIGEST` 传入。镜像 tag 相同不能作为镜像相同的证据。
+
+## 采集内容
+
+| 类别 | 内容 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 驱动 / 固件 / CANN | 安装及版本文件、latest 的实际目标、关键运行库内容哈希、额外 OPP 路径 |
+| 硬件与容器 | npu-smi、拓扑、设备属性、CPU/NUMA、共享内存、meminfo、ulimit、cgroup 限制、内核模块 |
+| Python 环境 | 解释器及真实路径、sys.path、全部包版本和安装位置、editable/direct_url 来源 |
+| 实际导入 | torch/torch_npu/acl/Transformers/vLLM/vllm_ascend/Ray/ModelOpt/MindSpeed 等的来源和异常 |
+| 内容一致性 | 相关包的 Python 源码、JSON/YAML 和原生 .so 哈希，Git HEAD、dirty diff 哈希和 untracked 列表 |
+| 动态库 | 导入进程 `/proc/self/maps` 中实际映射库的绝对路径、realpath、SHA256；ldconfig 搜索表 |
+| 运行配置 | Ascend/HCCL/torch/vLLM/Ray/线程/内存相关环境变量，PATH、PYTHONPATH、LD_LIBRARY_PATH 等 |
+| 输入 | 模型权重、tokenizer/processor/config、自定义代码、数据或其他 --asset 的完整哈希 |
+

+报告仍包含机器/安装路径、CI runner 名称等定位信息。
+
+边界：
+
+- 动态库列表属于独立导入进程，**不是实际 Ray worker 首次 forward 后的库全集**。
+  延迟加载的自定义 kernel 或 worker 内部改变的环境可能仍需第二轮定点采集。

+- 静态版本、资源占用或 CPU 数目不同本身不证明是精度根因。

+
+下载 CI artifact，把两边的 `report.json` 交给：

+
+先看 `diff.txt` 的 SOFTWARE / CONFIG / FILE CONTENT，再看 SYSTEM / RUNTIME。
+`diff.json` 是结构化结果。`--full` 还输出原始报告全部字段的 `full-diff.json`，
+包含安装路径、采集时间和内存瞬时值等噪声。
+
+包/模型文件按相对路径和内容比对，避免仅因安装路径或 mtime 不同就误报。
+实际加载库按 basename + 所有不同哈希对照，避免相同 SONAME 的多个版本相互覆盖。
+完整原始路径仍保存在报告中。
+

+ModelOpt/MindSpeed 的来源、任务队列/精度/编译相关环境变量、模型和 processor 内容。
+然后查看 pinned host memory 相关资源限制及是否有残留进程/资源压力。
+
+## 验证范围
+
+`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/utils -p 'test_*diagnostics_on_cpu.py'` 是 CPU 单元检查，验证脱敏、文件哈希变化、路径无关比较、

+def scrub(text):

+    def clean_url(match):

+def command(argv, timeout=30, cwd=None):

+HASH_CACHE = {}

+def file_info(path, hash_file=True):

+        if hash_file:

+def walk(root, limit=100000):
+    """Bound discovery and expose truncation instead of silently implying exhaustive coverage."""
+    paths, errors = [], []
+    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root, onerror=lambda e: errors.append(str(e))):
+        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", "__pycache__", ".cache", "node_modules"))
+        for name in sorted(files):
+            paths.append(Path(directory) / name)
+            if len(paths) >= limit:

+    return paths, {"truncated": False, "errors": errors}

+def manifest(root, predicate=lambda p: True, hash_file=True):
+    files, coverage = walk(root)

+        "coverage": coverage,

+def git_info(directory):

+        "root": root,
+        "head": command(["git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"]),
+        "status": command(["git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain"]),
+        "diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(diff.stdout).hexdigest() if diff.returncode == 0 else None,
+        "diff_returncode": diff.returncode,

+def fingerprints(report):
+    result = {}
+    for name, entry in report.get("module_files", {}).items():
+        for relative, info in entry.get("files", {}).items():
+            result[f"module/{name}/{relative}"] = info.get("sha256", info.get("error", "unhashed"))
+    for root, entry in report.get("cann", {}).items():
+        for relative, info in entry.get("files", {}).items():
+            # Ignore install root, retain subdirectory and every distinct observed binary.
+            key = f"cann/{relative}"
+            result.setdefault(key, set()).add(info.get("sha256", info.get("error", "unhashed")))
+    for path, info in report.get("loaded_libraries", {}).items():
+        result.setdefault(f"loaded/{Path(path).name}", set()).add(info.get("sha256", info.get("error", "unhashed")))
+    for root, entry in report.get("assets", {}).items():
+        for relative, info in entry.get("files", {"": entry}).items():
+            key = f"asset/{Path(root).name}/{relative}"
+            result.setdefault(key, set()).add(info.get("sha256", info.get("error", "unhashed")))
+    return {k: sorted(v) if isinstance(v, set) else v for k, v in result.items()}
+
+
+def flatten(value, prefix=""):
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        result = {}
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            result.update(flatten(item, f"{prefix}/{key}" if prefix else key))
+        return result
+    return {prefix: value}
+
+
+def selected(report):
+    modules = report.get("probe", {}).get("modules", {})
+    return {
+        "image_digest": report.get("image_digest"),
+        "collection_issues": report.get("collection_issues"),
+        "environment": report.get("environment", {}),
+        "packages": {k: v.get("version") for k, v in report.get("packages", {}).items()},
+        "module_imports": {
+            k: {field: v.get(field) for field in ("version", "git_version", "error")} for k, v in modules.items()
+        },
+        "python_version": report.get("python_version"),
+        "device": report.get("probe", {}).get("device"),
+        "torch_config": report.get("probe", {}).get("torch_config"),
+        "acl_version": report.get("probe", {}).get("acl_version"),
+        "precision_flags": report.get("probe", {}).get("precision_flags"),
+        "git": {
+            k: {
+                "head": v.get("head", {}).get("stdout"),
+                "diff_sha256": v.get("diff_sha256"),
+                "status": v.get("status", {}).get("stdout"),

+            for k, v in report.get("git", {}).items()
+        },
+        "fingerprints": fingerprints(report),
+        "runtime_system_files": report.get("system_files", {}),
+        "runtime_commands": {k: v.get("stdout", v.get("error")) for k, v in report.get("commands", {}).items()},
+    }

+

+            "left_present": key in left,
+            "right_present": key in right,
+            "left": left.get(key),
+            "right": right.get(key),
+        }
+        for key in sorted(left.keys() | right.keys())

+"""Summarize per-worker diagnostics without importing accelerator libraries."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def summarize(directory):
+    """Compare only same-model local transfer pairs, never incompatible TP layouts."""
+    result = {"stages": Counter(), "compared": 0, "mismatches": [], "nonfinite": [], "errors": [], "unpaired": 0}
+    for path in sorted(Path(directory).glob("*.jsonl")):
+        pending = {}
+        for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
+            try:
+                event = json.loads(line)
+                stage = event["stage"]
+                result["stages"][stage] += 1
+                tensors = {t["name"]: t for t in event["tensors"]}
+                for name, tensor in tensors.items():
+                    if tensor.get("nonfinite", 0):
+                        result["nonfinite"].append({"file": path.name, "line": number, "stage": stage, "name": name})
+                operation, _, position = stage.partition(".")
+                if operation not in ("offload", "reload"):
+                    continue
+                key = (operation, event["model_id"], event["call"])
+                if position == "before":
+                    pending[key] = tensors
+                elif position == "after":
+                    before = pending.pop(key, None)
+                    if before is None:
+                        result["unpaired"] += 1
+                        continue
+                    if before.keys() != tensors.keys():
+                        result["errors"].append({"file": path.name, "line": number, "tensor_names_changed": True})
+                    for name, tensor in tensors.items():
+                        old = before.get(name, {})
+                        if "sha256" not in old or "sha256" not in tensor:
+                            continue
+                        if any(old.get(k) != tensor.get(k) for k in ("local_shape", "dtype", "placements")):
+                            result["errors"].append({"file": path.name, "line": number, "layout_changed": name})
+                            continue
+                        result["compared"] += 1
+                        if old["sha256"] != tensor["sha256"]:
+                            result["mismatches"].append(
+                                {"file": path.name, "line": number, "stage": stage, "name": name}
+                            )
+            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
+                result["errors"].append({"file": path.name, "line": number, "error": str(exc)})
+        result["unpaired"] += len(pending)
+    result["interpretation"] = (
+        "No tensor values compared; metadata alone cannot establish weight integrity."
+        if not result["compared"]
+        else "Only recorded same-process local transfer pairs compared; values mode changes synchronization."
+    )
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    """Write the complete summary and print bounded counts for Actions."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("directory")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    report = summarize(args.directory)
+    output = Path(args.output)
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps({k: len(v) if isinstance(v, list) else v for k, v in report.items()}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def _tensor_record(name, tensor, values):
+    """Describe a local shard without invoking DTensor collectives."""
+    local = getattr(tensor, "_local_tensor", tensor)
+    record = {
+        "name": name,
+        "type": type(tensor).__name__,
+        "shape": list(tensor.shape),
+        "local_shape": list(local.shape),
